score_definition: TE-NAS component score follows official prune semantics: for each cell_type independently, compute origin and masked NTK/RN scores under the same projected supernet state, form relative deltas (origin - masked) / origin, rank higher NTK delta and lower RN delta, then use operation_score = -mean(ntk_prune_rank, rn_prune_rank); architecture score = sum selected edge-op operation scores
